about: The labels of a pattern, as CIP-05 gives them. celis writes them and every reader reads them, so both
must match this file: the CLI test writes a pattern with `celis pattern --binds` and finds the labels
of the form with `written` on it, then puts a record of each form in the store, and `celis patterns`
shows each as a plain pattern. The `grep` view marks it `old-rule` when `old_rule` is true.
`labels` are the `L` and `l` tags of the record. The other tags are those of CIP-05, "Patterns".

forms.name: a pattern as celis writes it
